mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer credit demand (RSAFS) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals an economic slowdown with stagflationary pressures, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or interaction signal Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-driven economic slowdown (indicated by declining industrial production), corporate production constraints reduce earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO decline > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the prior three months signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and INDPRO declines, or interaction signal Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
